_: AxiorHub 5.6.32 — fiches du guide d’utilisation (en) ; identifiants = registre fonctions5631 ; exemples fictifs

aujourdhui.objective: See on one screen what needs your attention today and run the firm’s routines.
aujourdhui.when: Every morning, or after an absence, to know what to handle first.
aujourdhui.prerequisites: None: the panels fill in as connections are set up.
steps: In “Routines du cabinet”, click “Briefing du matin” or “Tri des courriels”, then “Générer maintenant”.
Listen to the summary with “Écouter le briefing” if voice is enabled.
Use “Pause des automatismes” to suspend automatic processing.
aujourdhui.result: A dated briefing and the list of prepared work, to review before any action.
aujourdhui.verify: The routine panel shows the time of the last generation.
errors: Check in “Software status and help” that email and AI respond.
Automations may be paused: restart them with “Pause des automatismes”.
aujourdhui.example: Monday briefing: two fictitious hearings (DEMO-A, DEMO-B) and three emails to review.

dossiers.objective: Find a case, open its file and link the cases present in your files.
dossiers.when: To start working on a matter or register an existing one.
dossiers.prerequisites: A document space set up (local folder or Nextcloud).
steps: Type a name or reference, then click “Rechercher”.
For a matter missing from the list, give its folder then “Vérifier et enregistrer le dossier”.
Open the case to see its file, parties and timeline.
dossiers.result: The case appears in the portfolio with its working file.
dossiers.verify: The file shows the folder name and the date it was last read.
errors: Check that the folder is under the authorised root in Settings.
Run “Indexer progressivement tous les dossiers enregistrés”.
dossiers.example: Case DEMO-A — SAS Example v. Test Company, reference 2026-001.
buttons: Indexer progressivement tous les dossiers enregistrés

courriels.objective: Read the inbox, review prepared drafts and reply, forward or file.
courriels.when: When a message arrives or an agent draft awaits your review.
courriels.prerequisites: Email set up (IMAP receiving; SMTP sending is optional).
steps: Open Emails; the Inbox tab lists the messages.
Click a message to display it, then choose Reply, Reply all or Forward.
For a prepared draft, review and correct it before any sending.
Use “Rechercher” to find an exchange and “Actualiser” to reload the list.
courriels.result: A draft placed in your Drafts folder; nothing is sent without your confirmation.
courriels.verify: The draft is visible in the Drafts folder of your usual email client.
errors: Check the server, the port (993 or 143) and the encryption in Settings.
First select a message in the list.
courriels.example: Reply to a fictitious colleague on case DEMO-A, saved as a draft.

planning.objective: See the events of your authorised calendars and add one.
planning.when: To check a hearing date or record an appointment.
planning.prerequisites: An authorised calendar (CalDAV or Google) for writing; read-only is enough to view.
steps: Open “＋ Ajouter un événement” and enter date, time and title.
Set your reminders then “Enregistrer les rappels”.
planning.result: The event appears in the list and in the chosen calendar.
planning.verify: Open your usual calendar: the event is there at the same time.
errors: The calendar is read-only: choose a calendar authorised for writing in Settings.
No calendar is authorised: add one in Settings › Connections.
planning.example: Fictitious hearing on 24 November 2026 at 9:30, case DEMO-A.

taches.objective: Follow your tasks and add one.
taches.when: To note work to be done or see what is overdue.
steps: Open Calendar and tasks, then the Tasks view.
Use “Filtrer” to show one case or overdue tasks only.
In “Ajouter une tâche”, enter the title and due date then “Ajouter la tâche”.
With Nextcloud, “↻ Actualiser depuis Nextcloud” reloads the list.
taches.result: The task appears in the list, grouped by due date.
taches.verify: The task remains visible after reloading the page.
errors: Check the authorised task list in Settings.
taches.example: Chase the court registry for fictitious case DEMO-B before Friday.

production.objective: See what AxiorHub actually produced and start a production.
production.when: To find a deliverable or start preparing a document.
steps: Browse the sections (letters, pleadings, hearings, exhibits, invoicing).
Resume a workflow in progress with “Continuer les playbooks”.
production.result: The deliverable appears in its section with its check status.
production.verify: Each deliverable shows its date and the checks performed.
errors: Open “Software status and help” to see why.
production.example: Fictitious draft letter for DEMO-A, to review.

documents.objective: Ask the agent for a document and open recent files.
documents.when: To obtain a draft letter or note from an instruction.
documents.prerequisites: A document space and AI set up.
steps: In “Demander un document à l’agent”, describe the document and choose the case.
Open the result with “Afficher” and review it.
documents.result: A draft document in the chosen case, never sent automatically.
documents.verify: The file appears under “Modifiés récemment ici”.
errors: Check that the case is under an authorised root.
documents.example: Fictitious letter requesting documents for DEMO-A.

echeances.objective: Calculate, simulate and record procedural deadlines.
echeances.when: After a notification or notice, to know and record the deadline.
echeances.prerequisites: A calendar authorised for writing to record it.
steps: In “Ajouter ou simuler une échéance”, enter the event and the start date.
Click “Calculer” and check the rule applied.
Click “Enregistrer et inscrire à l’agenda” if the calculation suits you.
echeances.result: A calculated deadline, with its legal basis, recorded in the calendar if you choose.
echeances.verify: “Vérifier l’agenda maintenant” confirms the event is present.
errors: The calculation remains a proposal: check the rule and the starting point.
echeances.example: Fictitious appeal deadline calculated from a notification of 1 October 2026.

audience.when: A few days before a hearing.
audience.prerequisites: The case and its exhibits accessible.
steps: Review the expected exhibits, the oral argument notes and the likely questions.
audience.result: A hearing sheet to review, with its sources.
audience.verify: Each item of the sheet refers to an exhibit of the case.
errors: The latest pleadings were not found: place them in the case.
audience.example: Fictitious sheet for the DEMO-A hearing on 24 November 2026.

audiences_word.objective: Prepare an oral argument from the latest pleadings and analyse a Word document.
audiences_word.when: To compare claims or review a DOCX without changing it.
audiences_word.prerequisites: The case and AI set up.
steps: For a Word file, use “Analyser le DOCX sans le modifier”.
audiences_word.result: An outline of the oral argument or an analysis of the document, the original remaining intact.
audiences_word.verify: The original file keeps its modification date.
errors: Check the name and location of the pleadings in the case.
audiences_word.example: Fictitious outline comparing the claims of DEMO-A and the opposing party.
buttons: Analyser le DOCX sans le modifier

missions_complexes.objective: Delegate the preparation of a summons or pleadings in checked sub-tasks.
missions_complexes.when: For a long document requiring reading of exhibits, research and drafting.
missions_complexes.prerequisites: Document space and AI set up; a firm Word template is recommended.
steps: Open “Lancer une mission (assignation ou conclusions)” and choose the case.
Follow the sub-tasks and answer the decisions requested.
missions_complexes.result: A checked draft, with its sources and the points to verify.
missions_complexes.verify: Each sub-task shows its status and result.
errors: A decision is requested from you: answer it to resume.
missions_complexes.example: Fictitious draft reply pleadings for DEMO-A.

pieces.objective: Prepare an exhibit list with numbered and stamped exhibits.
pieces.when: Before communicating exhibits to a colleague or the court.
pieces.prerequisites: The PDF exhibits in the case; an exhibit list template is optional.
steps: Fill in your profile and stamp then “Enregistrer le profil”.
In “Préparer un bordereau”, choose the case then “Analyser les PDF du dossier”.
Check titles and numbers, preview all pages then confirm.
pieces.result: A new version of the exhibit list and stamped exhibits. Creating the file is not communication to a party.
pieces.verify: Open the list: each exhibit has a number and a title.
errors: Replace the PDF with a readable or OCR-scanned version.
pieces.example: Fictitious list of 12 exhibits for DEMO-A.

profils.objective: Approve the procedural profiles used to suggest steps and deadlines.
profils.when: Before using a procedure for the first time.
steps: Open a profile (for example “Tribunal judiciaire au fond”).
Click “Approuver” if the profile suits you.
profils.result: The profile becomes usable, with the date of your approval.
profils.verify: The profile is no longer marked “non approuvé”.
errors: Do not approve it: it will not be suggested.
profils.example: Fictitious profile “interim proceedings before the president of the court”.

strategie.objective: Work on a case’s strategy in a dedicated space.
strategie.when: To consider a case’s options before drafting.
strategie.result: A strategy space specific to the case.
strategie.verify: Your notes stay attached to the case.
errors: First register the case in Cases.
strategie.example: Fictitious options: settlement or summons for DEMO-B.

studio.objective: Choose a deliverable and prepare it with checks, from a single screen.
studio.when: To quickly produce a standard document.
studio.prerequisites: AI set up; a firm Word template is recommended.
steps: Choose a deliverable, for example “Courrier Word” or “Conclusions”.
Enter the case and the instruction.
studio.result: A checked draft in the case.
studio.verify: The draft shows the checks passed and the points to verify.
errors: Import your template in Firm documents.

playbooks.objective: Follow a guided workflow for a frequent task.
playbooks.when: To analyse opposing pleadings, prepare a hearing, review a contract or a formal notice.
playbooks.example: Fictitious analysis of opposing pleadings for DEMO-A.

recherche.objective: Find an email, file, event or note in the firm.
recherche.when: When you are looking for information without knowing where it is.
recherche.prerequisites: None; the search is fully local.
steps: Filter by case or period if needed.
recherche.result: The list of items found, ranked by relevance.
recherche.verify: Open a result to check its content.
errors: The index may not be up to date: see “État de l’index”.

recherche_juridique.objective: Search texts and decisions without sending client data.
recherche_juridique.when: To find the basis of an argument.
recherche_juridique.prerequisites: A legal source set up for external searches.
steps: Phrase the legal question without names or identifying data.
Check the references before using them.
recherche_juridique.result: Leads to texts and decisions with their source.
recherche_juridique.verify: Each reference can be opened and checked.
errors: Check the connection in Legal sources.
recherche_juridique.example: Fictitious question: limitation period for a warranty claim.

verification.objective: Check legal citations and mandatory statements, and run an adversarial review.
verification.prerequisites: The draft accessible in the case.
steps: Click “Vérifier les citations”, “Contrôler les mentions” or “Relecture contradictoire”.
verification.result: A list of points to correct or verify, with their source.
verification.verify: An unchecked reference stays marked “À vérifier”.
errors: Do not use it until it has been verified.
verification.example: Fictitious check of an article cited in draft pleadings.

sources.objective: Check the status of legal sources and set their use.
sources.when: If a legal search fails or to check outgoing requests.
steps: Look at the outgoing request log.
sources.result: The status of each source and the log of the last 30 requests.
sources.verify: An available source shows as such after the test.
errors: Check its key or access with the provider.

veille.objective: Receive a scheduled, dated and sourced legal watch on your topics.
veille.when: Every morning or on chosen days; on demand with “Actualiser”.
veille.prerequisites: Watch topics (Settings › Watch and Internet search); optional: enabled legal source, Tavily key.
steps: Open Settings › Watch and Internet search and enter your topics.
Choose the official feeds and the frequency, then save.
Read each item and open its source.
veille.result: A list of dated items with their source, also summarised in Today.
veille.verify: The frame shows the last successful check and the next run.
errors: An unavailable source is named; the others are published.
Check your keywords and the date of the last check.

surveillance.objective: Monitor cases and recalculate the priority table.
surveillance.result: A table of cases to watch.
surveillance.verify: The table shows the date of the last calculation.
surveillance.example: Fictitious case DEMO-B flagged: deadline approaching.

engagements.objective: Follow promises made in exchanges and the prepared follow-ups.
engagements.when: So as not to forget what was promised to a client or colleague.
engagements.result: The list of commitments with their source.
engagements.verify: Each commitment refers to the original message.
errors: Dismiss it: it will no longer be suggested.
engagements.example: Fictitious commitment: send the draft to the client before 15 October.

accueil_administratif.objective: Receive and handle incoming administrative calls and messages.
accueil_administratif.when: If you use phone or WhatsApp reception.
accueil_administratif.prerequisites: Telephony set up (Twilio) with a public HTTPS address.
steps: Adjust reception in Settings if necessary.
accueil_administratif.result: The list of administrative requests received.
accueil_administratif.verify: A received request appears with its time.
errors: The receiving address must be reachable by Twilio (not localhost).
accueil_administratif.example: Fictitious appointment request received by phone.

contacts.objective: Manage the firm’s correspondents and their role in each case.
contacts.when: To indicate who is client, colleague or party.
steps: Link them to a case then “Enregistrer l’association”.
Correct their role then “Enregistrer le rôle”.
contacts.result: The correspondent is linked to the case with their role.
contacts.verify: The case file mentions this correspondent.
errors: Correct it in “Corriger le rôle ou retirer”.
contacts.example: Fictitious contact: opposing counsel in DEMO-A.

associations.when: When messages are not linked to the right case.
steps: Link an address directly if needed.
associations.result: Messages from these addresses are linked to the case.
associations.verify: New messages from the address appear in the case.
errors: Remove it; it will no longer be suggested.
associations.example: Fictitious address contact@test-company.example linked to DEMO-A.

orchestrateur.objective: Match emails with cases and prepare draft notices.
orchestrateur.when: To handle notifications received by email.
steps: Prepare a notice with “Préparer sans action externe”.
orchestrateur.result: Draft notices to review; no external action.
errors: Link its address to the case in Suggested associations.

missions.objective: Give the agent an assignment and follow its progress.
missions.when: To delegate a task described in plain language.
steps: Follow its status and answer the questions asked.
missions.result: A tracked assignment, with results to review.
missions.verify: The assignment shows its status and result.
errors: The request exceeds the authorised mandate: rephrase it.
missions.example: Fictitious assignment: summarise the exchanges in case DEMO-B.

assistant.objective: Talk with the assistant about the firm and its cases.
assistant.when: For a quick question or a general search.
steps: Find the exchange in the history.
assistant.result: An answer with its sources when possible.
assistant.verify: The cited sources can be opened.

cabinet.objective: Access firm management: time, appointments, conflicts, limitation, reporting.
steps: Choose the section (Time and fees, Appointments, Conflicts of interest…).
See the access log for sensitive data if needed.
cabinet.result: Access to the firm’s management tools.
cabinet.verify: Each section opens on its own page.
errors: Data appears as the firm’s activity grows.
cabinet.example: Fictitious look at this month’s reporting.

honoraires.objective: Approve time spent and estimate work done.
honoraires.when: At the end of the day or before invoicing.
steps: Review the time entries to approve.
Click “Estimer à partir des courriels, pièces et rendez-vous”.
Adjust the rate scale then “Enregistrer le barème”.
honoraires.verify: The total per case is updated.
honoraires.example: Fictitious time: 1 h 30 of drafting for DEMO-A.
buttons: Estimer à partir des courriels, pièces et rendez-vous

rendez_vous.when: Before or after a client meeting.
steps: Prepare it or write the minutes.
rendez_vous.result: A prepared appointment or minutes to review.
rendez_vous.verify: The minutes are attached to the case.
errors: It must be in an authorised calendar.
rendez_vous.example: Fictitious meeting with the DEMO-B client.

steps: If necessary, manage the production block (“Désactiver le blocage”).
errors: Check the spelling of the names and run it again.

prescriptions.objective: Calculate and track limitation periods and time bars.
prescriptions.when: When opening a case or before acting.
steps: Enter the rule and the starting point.
Click “Créer (à confirmer)” to track the deadline.
prescriptions.result: A calculated deadline with its text, to confirm.
prescriptions.verify: The deadline appears in the list with its end date.

pilotage_mensuel.objective: View the month’s indicators and export them.
pilotage_mensuel.when: At the end of the month.
pilotage_mensuel.result: The month’s indicators: cases, deadlines, time, drafts, quality.
pilotage_mensuel.verify: The exported file contains the same figures.

assistance_metier.objective: Perform checkable calculations and prepare the billing review.
assistance_metier.when: For an interest calculation, an indexation or a billing review.
steps: Choose the calculation, for example “Calculer les intérêts simples” or “Calculer une indexation”.
For invoicing, use “Préparer la revue de facturation”.
assistance_metier.verify: The calculation details are shown line by line.
errors: Check the dates and rate entered.
assistance_metier.example: Fictitious interest on €10,000 from 1 January to 30 June 2026.

modeles_word.objective: Import your Word templates, check their tags and preview every page.
modeles_word.when: To produce letters in the firm’s layout.
modeles_word.prerequisites: LibreOffice installed for the preview (on Windows as on Linux).
steps: Check the detected tags and every page, then approve the template.
modeles_word.result: An approved template used for new drafts; the original is not changed.
modeles_word.verify: The preview shows each page of the template with a fictitious example.
errors: Type it in one piece, for example {{destinataire}}.

modeles_actes.objective: Manage deed templates and their mandatory statements.
modeles_actes.when: To prepare compliant pleadings or deeds.
modeles_actes.verify: The template is suggested when preparing a deed.

mon_style.objective: Analyse your writing to reproduce your style.
steps: Refine with “Affiner avec l’IA” if needed.
mon_style.result: Style habits to approve, then applied.

progres.objective: Set the tone per recipient and “always do it this way” rules.
steps: Correct a tone with “Corriger la détection”.
Add a rule with “Créer la règle”; “Valeurs d’origine” restores the settings.
progres.result: Rules applied to the next drafts.
progres.verify: The rule appears in the list of rules.
errors: Delete it or restore the original values.
progres.example: Fictitious rule: always address clients formally.

agents.objective: Create a document agent described in plain language.
steps: Open Agents and rules then “Nouvel agent”.
Describe the assignment then “Interpréter la mission”.
Check with “Tester le déclencheur sans agir”.
agents.result: An active agent under “Mes agents et règles par défaut”.
errors: Specify the target case and document type.
agents.example: Fictitious agent: file adjournment notices in the relevant case.

agents_documents.objective: See document agent results and resume processing.
agents_documents.result: The list of processing runs with their status.
agents_documents.verify: Each result refers to the processed document.
errors: See the cause then resume it.
agents_documents.example: Fictitious result: adjournment notice filed in DEMO-A.

regles.objective: Set the autonomy level and email processing rules.
regles.when: To decide what the agent may do on its own.
steps: Choose a level then “Activer ce niveau”.
Add a rule with “Ajouter la règle”.
Learn from a correction with “Enregistrer la correction”.
regles.verify: Active rules are listed with their effect.
errors: Return to a more cautious level.
regles.example: Fictitious rule: file newsletters without reply.

autonomie.objective: See what remains subject to your approval and adjust autonomy.
autonomie.when: To control or reduce the agent’s autonomy.
steps: Look at “Toujours soumis à votre validation”.
If in doubt, “Tout passer en mode prudent”.
autonomie.verify: The settings history records the change.
autonomie.example: Fictitious setting: suggest only, for drafts.

apprentissage.objective: Create practice rules and declare reliable references.
apprentissage.when: To pass a firm preference on to the agent.
steps: In “Créer une règle métier”, describe the rule then “Enregistrer la règle”.
Declare a reliable document then “Enregistrer la référence fiable”.
apprentissage.example: Fictitious rule: cite texts in their applicable version.

projets.when: Regularly, to approve or dismiss drafts.
projets.verify: An approved draft appears in its section.
errors: Dismiss it; your correction is remembered.

preparation.objective: See the next work spotted and source coverage.
preparation.result: The list of the next work spotted.
errors: Not all sources may be connected.
preparation.example: Fictitious work spotted: DEMO-A hearing to prepare.

memoire.objective: Update the sent replies remembered by the agent.
memoire.when: After sending messages, to enrich the memory.
memoire.result: An up-to-date memory of sent replies.
memoire.verify: Recent items appear in the list.
errors: Check the Sent folder in Settings.

parametres.objective: Set up the software’s connections and preferences.
parametres.when: To change a setting or test a connection.
parametres.prerequisites: The administrator role for shared settings.
steps: Open Settings then the section you need.
Test with “Tester IMAP”, “Tester Nextcloud / agendas” or “Tester Ollama”.
parametres.result: Settings saved, without reloading the page.
parametres.verify: The test message states what was actually checked.
errors: Read the cause shown and correct the setting concerned.
parametres.example: Fictitious setting: IMAP port 993, automatic encryption.

guide_installation.objective: Set up services step by step and check connections.
guide_installation.when: At first start-up, or to add a feature.
steps: Choose the functions you are interested in.
Fill in each screen then “Continue”; “Check the connection” tests without sending anything.
On the summary, click “Finish and apply”.
guide_installation.result: Settings applied and the list of available functions.
guide_installation.verify: The summary separates available functions from connections to complete.
errors: Another screen changed a setting: reload and check the flagged fields.
guide_installation.example: Fictitious path: local folder and Ollama, without email.

guide_utilisation.objective: Find out how to use a function.
guide_utilisation.when: When you do not know where to do something.
steps: Open Settings then “User guide”, or “Help for this page” at the top of the screen.
Search for a function or a need.
Open the sheet then “Open this function”.
guide_utilisation.result: The function’s sheet with its steps.
guide_utilisation.verify: The buttons cited in the sheet exist on the screen.

mise_en_service.objective: Check real services, the microphone and Docker.
mise_en_service.when: After an installation or an update.
steps: Test the microphone with “Tester le micro”.
Run “Lancer la recette de production” for a full check.
mise_en_service.result: A check report with the suggested fixes.
mise_en_service.verify: The “Dernier rapport” shows the date and the result.
errors: The browser requires an HTTPS address for the microphone.
mise_en_service.example: Fictitious report: services active, microphone allowed.

diagnostic.objective: Understand why nothing is produced: services, errors, blocked cases, connections.
diagnostic.when: When an expected processing does not appear.
steps: Look at Services and the work queue.
Test with “Tester la messagerie”, “Tester Nextcloud” or “Tester l’IA”.
Read the errors of the last seven days.
diagnostic.result: The cause of the block and the next action.
diagnostic.verify: After the fix, the relevant test succeeds.
errors: Restart the application or the service concerned.
diagnostic.example: Fictitious diagnosis: AI unreachable for 2 hours.

etat_systeme.objective: View incidents, recent processing, services and index.
steps: Open “Voir le détail” on an incident.
etat_systeme.result: The status of services and processing.
etat_systeme.verify: Each service shows its last check.
errors: Open its details and follow the suggested fix.

mcp.objective: Manage MCP legal connectors, skills and extensions.
mcp.when: To add a legal source or a skill.
steps: Test it then activate it for the functions you want.
mcp.result: A saved connector, active only after your choice.
mcp.verify: The connector appears with its authorised functions.
errors: Check the address and key with the provider.

routage.objective: Decide when an external AI may be used, and at what cost.
steps: Estimate with “Calculer le routage et le coût”.
See the data sent with “Afficher les données et le coût”.
routage.result: A routing policy applied before any sending.
routage.verify: The latest routing decisions are listed.
errors: Reduce the authorised functions or the cap.
routage.example: Fictitious policy: local first, external for long drafting.
buttons: Calculer le routage et le coût
Afficher les données et le coût

steps: Add a case then “Enregistrer le cas”.
evaluations.result: A ranking of models on your cases.
evaluations.verify: Each case shows each model’s result.
evaluations.example: Fictitious case: classifying a service contract.

tracabilite.objective: Know what the model saw on a case and which models were used.
tracabilite.result: The list of the model’s accesses to the case.
tracabilite.verify: Models used over 30 days are listed.

qualite.objective: Understand blocking reasons and draft corrections.
qualite.when: To improve the quality of drafts.
steps: Look at the corrections of sent drafts.
qualite.result: The main reasons for blocking and correction.
qualite.verify: The figures change after your corrections.
errors: It appears as processing goes on.

ecosysteme.objective: Register the services used by the firm.
ecosysteme.verify: The service is listed with its address.

administration.objective: Manage automations, shortcuts and advanced checks.
steps: Enable or pause an automation (“Mettre en pause”).
administration.verify: The status of each automation is shown.

tableau_de_bord.when: If you prefer this display to the current screens.
steps: Click “Analyser les dossiers actifs” or “Repérer le travail à faire”.
tableau_de_bord.verify: Items link to the relevant screens.

a_propos.objective: Know the version, the licence and the privacy rules.
steps: Read the version and the licence.
a_propos.verify: The version number matches the update note.

competences.objective: Give the AI a written working method (analysis, drafting, checking).
competences.when: So that a type of work is always done the same way, with your checks.
steps: Enable a built-in skill or copy it to adapt it.
To write one, fill in the form then click “Créer”.
To reuse one, choose the file then click “Importer”.
competences.result: The skill appears in the list, with its version and origin.
competences.verify: An active skill shows any missing prerequisites.
errors: Only text is accepted: scripts and executables are blocked.
competences.example: Fictitious skill “Review of a commercial lease”.
